chunks: 4159 - He said: And I asked him about an enclosure made of reeds that is set for fish in the water, then the fish enter it, and some of them die in it.
He said: "There is no harm in it."

key_terms.الْحَظِيرَةِ: an enclosure or pen used for trapping
key_terms.الْقَصَبِ: reeds used to construct the enclosure
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to use a reed enclosure in the water for catching fish if some of the fish die inside it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning fish trapped in a reed enclosure placed in the water. It states that there is no problem with such a case when some fish die inside it, indicating permissibility in this fishing method.
